instincts.trigger: Starting any code change in this repository
instincts.action: Read docs/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md, docs/ai/WORK_STATUS.md, and AGENTS.md first, then make the smallest behavior-preserving change.
Use conventional commits: type(scope): imperative summary (e.g. feat(explore): ..., fix(security): ...), and cite verification gates in the body when they ran.

instincts.trigger: Adding or changing a user-owned API resource (profiles, saved, tracking, matching)
instincts.action: Require IsAuthenticated, scope get_queryset() to request.user, assign the owner in perform_create(), and mark ownership/moderation fields read_only in the serializer.

instincts.trigger: Tempted to write scholarships, scholarship_sources, or ingestion_logs from the React client
instincts.action: Do not add the write. Route catalogue mutations through the staff-only ingestion endpoint or Django admin; the public catalogue stays read-only.
Persist through backend/scholarships/services.py using update_or_create on a stable slug, replace child rules/documents, and keep repeated runs idempotent (created=0 updated=N).

instincts.trigger: Changing eligibility thresholds, scoring, or rule handling
instincts.action: Update both engines together (Python eligibility_service.py and TS src/utils/eligibilityEngine.ts), keep explicit criterion statuses and explanations, and run the parity tests.

instincts.trigger: Building or restyling any user-facing UI
instincts.action: Compose from src/components/ui/ primitives, import icons through Icon.tsx, and use semantic tokens from src/index.css instead of raw hex values.

instincts.trigger: About to display counts, statistics, testimonials, or provenance claims
instincts.action: Use real data or explicitly state the gap; never introduce fabricated stats, mock testimonials, or invented deadlines.

instincts.trigger: Consuming Firestore or API data in the frontend
instincts.action: Validate the document shape with a type guard before use and fall back to the verified static catalogue while surfacing the fallback reason; a TypeScript cast is not validation.

instincts.trigger: Opening an external URL supplied by data
instincts.action: Route it through OfficialRedirectModal; never bypass or weaken the redirect gate.

instincts.trigger: Rendering user or catalogue text in JSX
instincts.action: Use plain JSX text so React escapes it; do not introduce dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

instincts.trigger: Configuring Django settings, auth, or an endpoint
instincts.action: Keep DEBUG/SECRET_KEY/ALLOWED_HOSTS env-driven, keep CSRF enabled for state-changing session endpoints, compare OAuth state in constant time, and throttle expensive endpoints.

instincts.trigger: Finishing a feature or multi-step task
instincts.action: Run the definition of done (npm run lint, relevant unit suites, npm run build, npx playwright test; backend: manage.py check + pytest) and record the outcome plus commit hash in docs/ai/WORK_STATUS.md.

instincts.trigger: A test is failing or a build is blocked
instincts.action: Fix the implementation instead of deleting or weakening the existing test; add regression coverage where relevant.

instincts.trigger: Migrating or rewriting an API layer
instincts.action: Preserve existing URLs, JSON field names, envelopes, and status codes; add a compatibility endpoint and contract tests before replacing behavior.
